After TASK-215 publication, production-shaped downstream replay exposed one remaining identity conflation before any TASK-259 RUN or new handoff was created. That helper requires importlib.metadata's installed operator path to equal the current module __file__; under the deliberate control-source topology those paths belong to 31fd2482... and 4b397a... respectively, so staging failed with "imported package differs from active installed generation". The TASK-215 regression masked this production topology by monkeypatching _installed_generation_sha to the source SHA. The missing correction is a narrow distinction between reviewed control-source identity and the already-attested installed migration-source identity during source-upgrade history validation.
